body.statement: In the adaptive-experiment framework of Freidling, Zhao, and Gao, Proposition 2 states that A2--A3 give the conditional-law representation obtained by independent candidate-action resampling restricted to the same selector, while A1 together with imputability of the test statistic, selector, and action mass with respect to \(\mathcal G\) makes that reference distribution computable.

source.verbatim_statement: Under Assumptions (A2) and (A3), the selective randomization distribution is given by; If Assumption (A1) holds ... p-value is computable

attestation.note: Directly checked arXiv:2405.07026v4 primary PDF on 2026-09-14. Proposition 2 assigns A2-A3 to formula (9), and assigns A1 plus imputability of T, q, and S with respect to G to computability/formula (10); its proof uses equations (5)-(7).
